title: Retention rollback traces and replayable evidence chain for prompt artifacts
creator: Marta Novak
description: Provide a system-level capability to capture lightweight retention rollback traces (time-versioned snapshots of retention metadata and routing decisions) and produce a replayable evidence chain for prompt/response/request-log/metric artifacts. This feature enables: (1) reconstructing the state of retention decisions at any historical point for auditing or legal requests, (2) producing signed, replayable evidence bundles that show chain-of-custody and transformations applied (sampling, redaction, shredding), and (3) integrating rollback traces with legal-hold workflows so artifacts that would otherwise be purged can be reconstituted for a bounded timeframe.
background: Customers and auditors increasingly ask not only for exported artifacts but for provenance — why a prompt was retained or purged, which policy evaluation produced that outcome, and whether artifacts were sampled or redacted. Current retention exports produce static bundles but do not include the time-bound decision graph required to recreate the system state that led to those bundles. This makes forensic requests and regulatory audits slow and error-prone. A rollback trace + replayable evidence chain solves for deterministic reconstruction without retaining full payloads indefinitely.
goals: Design a compact retention-trace schema that records policy inputs, evaluated rules, and retention actions (retain/purge/sampled/redact) without duplicating full request payloads
Expose an API and Console flow to generate a signed replayable evidence bundle for a specified time window and route
Integrate the traces with legal-hold flags so held artifacts can be surfaced even after nominal TTLs
Ensure cryptographic integrity of evidence bundles (signed manifests + artifact digests) and track export audit logs
acceptance_criteria: Schema draft reviewed and approved by Eng/Trust (includes fields: timestamp, route, policy_version, evaluation_inputs_hash, action, sample_rate, transform_log)
API endpoint: POST /v1/retention/replayable-bundle accepts route, time-window, and returns signed manifest + artifact pointers or inline artifacts for small exports
Console workbench allows legal/ops to request a replayable bundle, preview evaluation traces, and add a legal-hold that bumps retention for impacted artifacts
Evidence bundles include deterministic digests allowing integrity verification and a human-readable reconstruction log suitable for auditors
Load and storage costs modeled; sampling defaults applied so trace storage is bounded and costs are within P0 cost targets
tasks: Write PRD describing schema, API, UX flows (owner: PM)
Eng: implement trace emission hooks in retention orchestrator and policy evaluator (owner: ENG)
Eng: build signing service and export worker for bundle assembly
Design: console experience for bundle request, preview, and legal-hold toggle
Security/Trust review and threat model for cryptographic signing and export access
Run two-week pilot with partner customer for one route and collect feedback

notes: Implementation must avoid turning traces into a secondary retention system. Default behavior: traces are compact (hashes + pointers + small transform logs) and only materialize payloads when an authorized export is requested. Provide sampling presets per-route to meet cost targets. Coordinate with Billing for export egress costs.
